All Implemented Interfaces:
ca.uhn.fhir.model.api.IElement, Serializable, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBase, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseDatatype, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseElement, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseHasExtensions, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.ICompositeType
public class FhirRatio extends org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Ratio
This class is a subclass of Ratio. Therefore it contains a numerator and a denominator.
It contains functionalities for converting CDA R2 RTO and CDA R2 RTOPQPQ into HL7 FHIR Ratio and vice versa.
